cuts.head: turn_side
cuts.ofreeRecent: a resort cabana with a shaded daybed by the water — chest-deep in the water; a monastery library of tall wooden shelves — sets a cup down on the surface in front of her; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — sitting on the ground; a present-day immersive planetarium event foyer — testing a small hand-held star projector during an adult celestial-guide costume evening; an outdoor theatre of tiered seats facing a stage — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a Three Kingdoms festival street — standing; a modern flower-lined bicycle promenade beside a canal — taking a break on her own bicycle while watching floating fallen petals; a medieval guild workshop — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a candlelit gala dinner hall — holds a cup in both hands; a narrow path through a tall bamboo grove — standing; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — standing; the back seat of a taxi at night — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze — standing
